No keys were reported compromised.

Unbacked issuance on Liquid at 13:53:10 UTC (assessment; the original block 4,050,336 was later reorganized away; the 8 Sept Telegram report said 15:53:10 UTC, but the canonical block 4,050,335 is timestamped 13:52:10 UTC on the Blockstream explorer); a test peg-out of 2.5 L-BTC at about 14:00 UTC; the 4,000 L-BTC peg-out request at 14:05 UTC; release at 14:28:56 UTC, about 36 minutes after issuance. Other users' small peg-outs (4.14 BTC at 16:01:28 and 1.02 BTC at 16:48:45 UTC) were still signed before the halt.

No operator reimbursement of users reported.
